<!--
  The profile intro (model profile@1): the name as the heading, the role (the primary token), a description, the
  links of the person as a list of small outline links, and the portrait. Axes: media (end: the portrait after
  the copy, start: before it from md up, top: a disc over the copy).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ProfileLink } from "./profile-intro.types";

export type ProfileIntroProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  role: string;
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
  imageAlt: string;
  links: ProfileLink[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  media?: "end" | "start" | "top";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  role,
  description = "",
  image = "",
  imageAlt,
  links,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "start",
  media = "end",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ProfileIntroProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const frame = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "top" ? "flex flex-col items-center gap-8"
  : "grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-12 md:grid-cols-2"
);
const pictureCell = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "top" ? "order-first w-full"
  : (media as string) === "start" ? "order-first w-full"
  : "w-full"
);
const pictureClass = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "top" ? "mx-auto size-32 rounded-full"
  : "mx-auto w-full max-w-sm"
);
const linkRow = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "justify-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "justify-end"
  : "justify-start"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="profile-intro"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box :class="frame">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column">
          <Title :as="level" size="4xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="lg" weight="medium" :class="cn('text-primary', textAlign)">
            {{ role }}
          </Text>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
          <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('flex flex-wrap gap-2', linkRow))">
            <ListItem v-for="l in links" :key="l.id" data-slot="profile-link">
              <LinkButton variant="outline" size="sm" :href="urlOf(l.href)">
                {{ l.label }}
              </LinkButton>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Stack>
        <Box :class="pictureCell">
          <MediaFrame :alt="imageAlt" :src="image" ratio="1/1" :class="pictureClass" />
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
